items.title: Ron Carter — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Michael Jordan, he's their icon of the basketball world.

ctx.x: We mentioned Wes but not in this context, so just a few thoughts about Wes.

Uhmm… other than … amazing, and all caps in the word AMAZING, it's hard to describe him. You know, some of my friends are real sports fans, and basketball fans in this case. They always say … uh … to let me know how seriously they take sports – basketball. Michael Jordan, he's their icon of the basketball world. And okay, yeah. They say, "Michael Jordan, Michael Jordan," the guys play Michael Jordan. I say, "Wait a minute, man. I play Wes Montgomery." And there's not one guitar player on this planet who can do…
